stock.description: GigaDevice Semiconductor Inc., founded in Beijing, China, in 2005, specializes in the research, development, technical support, and global distribution of a broad array of semiconductor components. The company's diverse product portfolio includes various memory solutions such as SPI NOR, SPI NAND, parallel NAND, and advanced flash products like wafer-level chip scale packaging (WLCSP) and known good die (KGD), along with associated packaging. Its microcontroller lineup consists of 32-bit devices utilizing Arm Cortex-M architectures (M3, M4, M23, M33, M7) and RISC-V technology. Furthermore, GigaDevice provides sensors, including touch controllers, fingerprint recognition modules, and barometric pressure sensors. An extensive range of analog products is also offered, covering general power supply devices (such as low drop linear regulators and DC-DC converters), application-specific standard products (ASSPs) for DDR and TWS earbud power management, and various motor drivers (e.g., 3-Phase MOSFET pre-drivers, brushed DC motor drivers, multi-channel full-bridge drivers, and brushless DC motor driver SOCs). Other analog solutions include charging management and protection ICs, signal chain components like ADCs, operational amplifiers, comparators, and high-precision voltage references, alongside current monitors and temperature/humidity sensors, and BMS AFE products. Beyond its primary semiconductor operations, the company is involved in semiconductor market research, software technology development, technology consulting, property leasing, equity investments, business management consulting, and various IT and scientific services. Its diverse product portfolio serves key sectors including automotive, industrial, personal computers and peripherals, consumer electronics, the Internet of Things (IoT), network communication, and mobile applications. GigaDevice reaches its global customer base through direct operations and a broad network of distributors spanning China, Singapore, the United States, South Korea, Japan, the United Kingdom, Germany, Turkey, Italy, and Mexico. The company, initially known as GigaDevice Semiconductor (Beijing) Inc., adopted its current name, GigaDevice Semiconductor Inc., in August 2022.

moat.method: AI qualitative assessment anchored to dated financial statements and available transcript; not a reported accounting measure

provenance.ebitda: Analyst ebitdaAvg when supplied; otherwise analyst EBIT plus modeled D&A, explicitly derived. YTD operating EBITDA is reported operating EBIT plus cash-flow D&A, not an adjusted analyst measure.
provenance.depreciation: Analyst EBITDA minus EBIT when nonnegative and both available; otherwise modeled TTM D&A/revenue. Analyst measure definitions are not independently certified.
provenance.riskFreeRate: User-directed USD Treasury proxy under the HKD/USD peg; not an observed HKD yield or a copied US-stock WACC
provenance.tax: TTM effective tax; scenario assumption, not a marginal-rate forecast
provenance.kd: TTM accounting interest / average reported debt; not a current financing quote
provenance.erp: 4.75% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.beta: FMP profile beta; lookback, frequency and benchmark unspecified by the response
provenance.terminalG: 2.25% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.cash: All reported cash and short-term investments assumed nonoperating; adjustable
provenance.investments: Long-term investments assumed nonoperating at book value; adjustable, not fair-value evidence
provenance.priority: Preferred and minority book values are adjustable value proxies; cost defaults to common Ke
provenance.leases: Cash-flow-matched debt reconciliation: liabilities whose payments remain in FCFF are not deducted again; financing treatment requires matching profit, depreciation and reinvestment adjustments
